title: RunEvent
description: Immutable telemetry record emitted by the trusted harness. This is the single source catalog for every metric operand: the measurement dictionary may only reference eventType values and field names defined here.

eventType.description: Closed set of harness lifecycle events.

outcome.description: Outcome discriminator used by acceptance/failure metrics.

declaredComplete.description: Whether the agent declared the attempt complete (false-completion numerator source).

passedRequiredAssurance.description: Whether the attempt passed all mandatory assurance levels.

failureClass.description: Failure taxonomy class id when outcome is failed/rejected.

changeFailure.description: Whether a deployment caused a change failure (DORA CFR).

organizationId.description: Owning organization (additive v1.1.0; disp. P2-PLAN-HIGH-010, exit J2).

repositoryBindingId.description: Owning repository binding (additive v1.1.0; disp. P2-PLAN-HIGH-010, exit J2).

interventionKind.description: The accepted control a human.intervention event records (additive v1.2.0).

recoveryKind.description: How a workflow.recovered event recovered (additive v1.2.0).

approvalKind.description: The approval an approval.* event concerns (additive v1.2.0).

budgetScope.description: The budget a budget.threshold_crossed event concerns (additive v1.2.0).

thresholdKind.description: Which threshold a budget.threshold_crossed event crossed (additive v1.2.0).

workflowId.description: The durable workflow that emitted the event (additive v1.2.0).

attemptTerminal.description: The attempt's terminal as recordAttemptOutcome received it, on attempt.completed (additive v1.2.0).

verificationVerdict.description: The attempt's mandatory verification verdict, on attempt.completed; absent when verification never ran (additive v1.2.0).

adjudicationId.description: The assurance adjudication of the attempt, on attempt.completed; absent when no round completed (additive v1.2.0).

reviewRound.description: Assurance round of a review, attempt or repair event (additive v1.2.0).

reviewerRole.description: Role of the review source (additive v1.2.0).

reviewMode.description: Assurance mode of the round (additive v1.2.0).

assuranceOutcome.description: Outcome of the attempt's assurance round, on attempt.completed (additive v1.2.0).

shadowWouldBlock.description: What gating mode would have decided was not PROCEED, on attempt.completed (additive v1.2.0).

reviewFindingsUngrounded.description: Findings whose citation did not ground, on review.completed (additive v1.2.0).

reviewerFailed.description: The reviewer call failed, on review.completed (additive v1.2.0).

egressStopped.description: Egress stopped the reviewer request, on review.completed (additive v1.2.0).

reviewCostPriced.description: Every reviewer call of the round had a configured price (additive v1.2.0).

repairRound.description: The attempt was a repair attempt, on attempt.completed (additive v1.2.0).

repairClosedAllBlocking.description: The repair closed every blocking finding, on attempt.completed (additive v1.2.0).

findingId.description: Finding identity, the dedupe key of review.finding_dispositioned (additive v1.2.0).

findingValid.description: The disposition judged the finding valid, on review.finding_dispositioned (additive v1.2.0).

findingDisposition.description: Disposition of the finding, on review.finding_dispositioned (additive v1.2.0).

dispositionActorKind.description: Who disposed of the finding, on review.finding_dispositioned (additive v1.2.0).

reviewRoundCompletedAt.description: occurredAt of the disposed round's review.completed: the cohort key of review.finding_dispositioned (additive v1.2.0).

dispositionLatencyMs.description: Time from the round's completion to the disposition, on review.finding_dispositioned (additive v1.2.0).

assuranceUnavailable.description: The assurance activity failed and the attempt continued without a round, on attempt.completed (additive v1.2.0).
